prompt_en: gaunt steppe spirit in a ragged felt coat and pointed fur hat, ash-grey skin, long braided black hair, faintly glowing amber eyes, clawed hands, small dust whirl at its feet
nota: Dudosa: no identifico a Kermes; «kermes» es también un insecto tintóreo.

prompt_en: tall spectral archer in a fur-trimmed felt coat and pointed cap, pale blue translucent skin, drawing a long recurved horn bow, quiver of bone arrows on its back
nota: Dudosa: «mergen» significa arquero certero; no es una criatura concreta.

prompt_en: wrathful blue-skinned guardian in layered silk scarves and gilded armor, raising a golden thunderbolt scepter, crown of five jewels, ring of flames behind, standing on a lotus
nota: Ochirvani es Vajrapani, protector budista (no bestia). Solo lore o PNJ.

prompt_en: tall shaggy forest ogre with coarse brown fur, a single curved horn on its forehead, one very long crooked finger, goat-like ears and glowing yellow eyes
nota: Su dedo largo mata a cosquillas; atrápalo en un tronco hendido.

prompt_en: lean spectral hunter with teal-grey skin, coat of overlapping fish-scale plates, river-reed cap, bow of bleached driftwood, long wet hair dripping, quiver of fish-bone arrows
nota: Dudosa: «su» es agua en túrquico; probable cazador acuático, versión de Mergen.

prompt_en: colossal one-eyed ogre with stone-hard grey-brown skin, a single huge eye in the middle of its forehead, thick matted hair, massive bare fists and a rough hide kilt
nota: Piel como roca: solo el ojo único es punto débil.

prompt_en: powerful winged steppe horse with a glossy dark chestnut coat, broad feathered wings of white and gold, flowing silver mane and tail braided with ornamental ribbons, gleaming hooves
nota: Corcel de héroes; posible montura o aliado, a decidir.

prompt_en: gaunt pale vampire in tattered dark felt robes, sunken glowing red eyes, long sharp nails, elongated fangs, tangled black hair and a bat-like cloak
nota: Vampiro túrquico; ataca a los durmientes de noche.

prompt_en: tall moss-covered taiga spirit with a bark-like face, antler branches growing from its head, lichen beard, glowing green eyes, body of tangled roots and pine needles
nota: Categoría genérica de espíritus del bosque udege; usar con respeto.

prompt_en: slender pale underground dweller in a long grey-blue woolen tunic, faintly shimmering translucent skin, elongated fingers, silver-white hair, glowing violet eyes, carrying a small lantern
nota: Dudosa: parece el ulda sami (gente subterránea); el catálogo dice Siberia.

prompt_en: towering ogress with grey-green leathery skin, tangled waist-length white hair, a long hooked nose, heavy clawed hands and ragged sheepskin clothes, bundle of bones tied at her belt
nota: Ogresa devoradora; golpes lentos, hay que esquivar, no parar.

prompt_en: hunched old ogress in a faded patchwork felt coat and headscarf, sallow green-grey skin, a very long nose, iron-tipped walking stick, sack slung over her shoulder, wicked grin with crooked teeth
nota: Se disfraza de abuela amable; el aviso falso no daña.

prompt_en: long scaly dragon-serpent with dark green and bronze scales, two short horns, small forelegs with hooked claws, smoking nostrils and a spiked ridge along its back
nota: Categoría; «zmey» es palabra eslava, no tradición siberiana concreta.

prompt_en: colossal azure sea dragon with a long scaled body, antlered head, flowing white whiskers, golden pearl in its claws, four taloned limbs, mane of pale foam and a crown of coral
nota: Rey dragón del mar Este, aún venerado; jefe digno, sin caricatura.

prompt_en: colossal crimson sea dragon with long scaled body, antlered head, white whiskers, ember-orange mane, four taloned limbs, a glowing red pearl in its claws and coral-red crest
nota: Rey dragón del mar Sur (rojo); mismo cuerpo que Ao Guang.

prompt_en: colossal pearl-white sea dragon with long scaled body, antlered head, pale silver whiskers, frost-blue mane, four taloned limbs, a moonstone pearl in its claws and a crest of ice-like spines
nota: Rey dragón del mar Oeste (blanco); reskin de Ao Guang.

prompt_en: colossal midnight-black sea dragon with long scaled body, antlered head, grey whiskers, dark teal mane, four taloned limbs, a deep-blue pearl in its claws and a crest of black kelp-like fins
nota: Rey dragón del mar Norte (negro); invoca mareas y sirvientes.

prompt_en: large white tiger with bold black stripes, pale silver-blue eyes, long curved fangs, a faint mist of wind swirling around its shoulders and thick pale paws
nota: Duplica a «Baihu»: mismo tigre blanco, símbolo del Oeste.

prompt_en: calm white mule-like beast with a jade-green saddle blanket, small curved horns, cloud-like swirls around its hooves, long ears and golden eyes, red silk ribbons tied to its mane
nota: Dudosa: los Ocho Inmortales no tienen bestia canónica; quizá la mula de Zhang Guolao.

prompt_en: small roof-guardian dragon with a stout scaled body, fish-like upswept tail, wide open mouth showing rounded teeth, short horns, coiled stone-grey and teal scales, spouting a thin jet of water
nota: Dragón de tejado que apaga fuegos; escupe agua contra llamas.

prompt_en: composite mountain beast with an ox-like horned head, striped tiger body, bird feathers along the spine, a snake-like tail and mismatched eyes of amber and green
nota: Categoría; combinar al azar piezas de otras bestias del Shanhaijing.

prompt_en: wind-spirit beast with a deer's body covered in leopard spots, a sparrow-like head with short horns, broad grey feathered wings and a long snake tail, swirling cloud wisps at its hooves
nota: Ráfagas que desvían proyectiles; atácalo cuando el viento cae.

prompt_en: small crow-like bird with a patterned dark-and-white head, white beak, bright red feet and blue-black feathers, carrying a small pebble and a twig in its claws
nota: Insiste sin descanso; deja caer piedras desde lo alto.

prompt_en: dragon-horse with a powerful horse body covered in jade-green scales, a dragon's head with antlers, flaming mane, feathered fetlocks, spread wings and a long tufted tail
nota: Corre sobre el agua; presagio de que algo extraordinario llega.

prompt_en: slender blue-green bird with a crimson head, dark eyes, long trailing tail feathers, a silk message ribbon tied around one foot, shimmering turquoise wings
nota: Mensajeras celestiales en bandada; piden el corte de luna.

prompt_en: tiny one-legged mountain imp about knee-high with a wrinkled brown face, a single leg with a backward-facing heel, patchy fur, big round eyes and a tattered straw cape
nota: Causa fiebre; el estruendo de bambú ardiendo lo ahuyenta.

prompt_en: slender mountain spirit maiden in a cloak of fig leaves and wisteria vines, pale green skin, a red leopard at her side, mist curling around her feet
nota: Espíritu melancólico de la montaña; la niebla oculta a sus felinos.

prompt_en: celestial hound with sleek black fur, a white head, glowing golden eyes, long fiery streaking tail like a comet and sharp curved fangs, star-like specks in its coat
nota: Devora el sol y la luna en eclipses; golpea desde la sombra.

prompt_en: giant water ape with shaggy white head fur, golden glowing eyes, snow-white fangs, long powerful arms, mossy green-grey body and a rusted iron chain wrapped around its neck
nota: Provoca crecidas; una cadena de hierro lo ató: punto débil.

prompt_en: single-horned sacred beast with an ox-like muscular body, lion-like mane, dark green scales along its flanks, one long straight black horn, golden eyes and cloven hooves
nota: Embiste solo al culpable: ideal para un duelo de justicia.

prompt_en: headless giant warrior with two large eyes on his chest and a fanged mouth on his belly, bronze arm guards, tattered kilt, huge bronze axe and round shield
nota: Sigue luchando aunque lo derroten: pide varias fases.

prompt_en: sea-wind deity with a bird's body of dark blue feathers and a calm human face, two green snakes hanging from his ears, two red snakes coiled around his clawed feet
nota: Dios del viento y del mar Norte; híbrido humano-ave-serpiente, jefe único.

prompt_en: large eagle-sized bird with a long neck, glossy purple-green plumage, red beak and eyes, scaly legs and feather tips dripping pale green venom
nota: Ave que come serpientes; sus plumas envenenan al contacto.

prompt_en: child-sized spirit boy wearing a huge lotus-leaf rain hat and straw cape, pale blue-white face, round dark eyes, holding a glowing paper lantern, raindrops dripping from his sleeves
nota: Trae lluvia: apaga antorchas y resbala el suelo; casi inofensivo.

prompt_en: sea prophet with a scaly silvery body, a bird-like beak, three fin-like legs, shimmering blue-green scales, long flowing black hair and softly glowing eyes
nota: Profetiza cosechas y plagas; protege a quien guarde su imagen.

prompt_en: small hunched goblin with sickly reddish-brown skin, tangled black hair, bulging pale eyes, an extremely long red tongue, long dirty claws and tattered rag shorts
nota: Acecha en baños y rincones sucios; molesto más que mortal.

prompt_en: tall blue-skinned monk-like spirit in worn grey robes, bald head, long bony hands, glowing pale eyes, hunched posture, carrying a battered wooden staff and a wicker hat
nota: Monje azul nocturno; poco documentado, detalles variables según la fuente.

prompt_en: colossal ghostly whale skeleton, bleached bone ribs and jaw exposed, hollow glowing blue eye sockets, tattered pale skin remnants, trailing a swarm of spectral sea birds and fish
nota: Ballena-esqueleto con bandada fantasma: aves y peces como enjambre aparte.

prompt_en: giant rooster-like bird with a long tail of red and orange feathers, a crest of flame, sharp beak, strong clawed legs and pale ghostly fire streaming from its mouth
nota: Su fuego frío no quema; ciega más que daña.

prompt_en: small shadow spirit shaped like a faint dark smudge in the air, a pair of wooden sandals hovering beneath it, two pale round eyes and wet footprints trailing behind
nota: Pasos tras Akira; si se aparta y espera, el espíritu pasa.

prompt_en: old torn paper lantern spirit with one huge bulging eye, a long red tongue hanging from a ripped mouth, a single thin leg with a wooden sandal and a flickering flame glowing inside
nota: Misma base que Karakasa-obake; desfilan en grupo con luz falsa.

prompt_en: thin pale woman in a worn dark kimono with long black hair, her arms covered in dozens of small bird-like golden eyes, gaunt face, clutching copper coins
nota: Cien ojos en los brazos disparan miradas; avisan desde lejos.

prompt_en: billowing grey smoke spirit forming a vague tall human silhouette, hollow glowing orange eyes, curling arms of vapor, ember sparks drifting inside its chest, tapering into a trail of smoke
nota: Humo que cambia de forma; sus avisos falsos no hacen daño.

prompt_en: skeletal woman in a faded white kimono, long black hair over a bare skull face with hollow glowing blue eyes, thin bony hands holding a small paper lantern
nota: Se muestra como mujer hermosa; el esqueleto aparece al golpear.

prompt_en: colossal shark-like sea monster with rough sandpaper-like grey skin, a wide fanged mouth, tall dorsal fin, and a long barbed tail lined with fish-hook spines, barnacles on its back
nota: Su cola con garfios arrastra al mar; hay que cortarla primero.

prompt_en: emaciated ghoul with ashen skin stretched over ribs, swollen belly, sharp claws, long matted hair, glowing yellow eyes and a ragged white burial shroud
nota: Condenado por avaricia a devorar cadáveres; solo acecha de noche.

prompt_en: huge old ceramic sake jar with the grinning bald head of an old man rising out of its mouth, thin arms gripping the rim, cracked brown glaze
nota: Vasija de sake animada; su licor cura aliados o emborracha a Akira.

prompt_en: baby-sized river spirit with slick olive-green skin, round wet eyes, tiny webbed hands, tattered baby cloth wrap and reeds in its hair, sharp little teeth
nota: Llora junto al río para atraer viajeros; no recogerlo (según catálogo).

prompt_en: cow-sized beast with a brown cow's body and the solemn human face of a bearded old man, short horns, long tail, glowing white eyes and a paper charm tied at its neck
nota: Profetiza desastres y muere a los pocos días; su imagen protege.

prompt_en: large dark brown bat-like gliding beast with furry body, wide leathery membranes stretched between its limbs, small pointed ears, glowing yellow eyes and clawed feet
nota: Planea desde ramas y tapa la cara; el catálogo erra al decir «acuática».

prompt_en: shapeless humanoid lump of pale sagging flesh, wrinkled folds drooping over stubby limbs, faint blank face outlined in the skin, glistening grey-pink hide and a sour green haze
nota: Bulto de carne inofensivo y apestoso; su olor aturde.

prompt_en: colossal armored centipede with a long segmented dark red-brown body, hundreds of glinting bronze legs, huge curved venom fangs, glowing yellow eyes and long whip-like antennae
nota: Una flecha untada de saliva lo mató: debilidad en la cabeza.

prompt_en: hairy ape-like mountain creature with shaggy dark brown fur, a wrinkled humanlike face, large knowing eyes, long arms and a hunched posture
nota: Lee la intención de Akira: solo lo sorprende un golpe sin pensar.

prompt_en: hunched old woman spirit with wild white hair, wrinkled face, patched grey kimono, straw sandals, flinging handfuls of sand from a cloth sack, tiny glinting eyes
nota: Lanza arena a los ojos desde los árboles del camino; casi inofensiva.

prompt_en: small shaggy mountain beast like a dog with long reddish-brown fur, large pointed ears, a wide mouth open mid-call, bushy curled tail and bright round eyes
nota: Su eco llega antes que el golpe: avisa por sonido.

prompt_en: tall ghostly woman in a long white robe with extremely long black hair trailing to the floor, pale gaunt face, thin hands, faint cold glow around her
nota: Diosa doméstica del retrete; tratar con respeto, sin burla fácil.

prompt_en: pitch-black shadow figure shaped like a hunched human silhouette, featureless smooth body, two faint pale eyes, long drooping arms, edges smoking like dark mist
nota: Crece con el miedo y se encoge si Akira no se inmuta.

prompt_en: drowned ghost with algae-green skin, pondweed and shells tangled in long black hair, rotted indigo robe dripping water, glowing teal eyes and long thin hands reaching upward
nota: Categoría genérica; equivale a Mulgwishin (gwisin de agua), otra paleta.

prompt_en: slender golden-brown serpent with dark diamond markings, cream belly, small red-gold eyes and a ribbon of woven barley straw tied around its neck
nota: Dudosa: Jacheongbi es diosa agrícola de Jeju; su serpiente no consta.

prompt_en: squat horned imp with warty dark-green skin, pointed ears, wide fanged grin, long clawed fingers, short stubby tail and glowing yellow eyes
nota: Categoría moderna; «mogwai» es «monstruo» en chino, no coreano.

prompt_en: soaked white-robed water ghost with pale grey-blue skin, long dripping black hair hiding its face, thin arms reaching up from the water, wet cloth clinging to a hovering body
nota: Arrastra a los vivos bajo el agua para tomar su lugar.

prompt_en: large crow with three clawed legs, glossy black plumage tinged with gold, a halo of warm sunlight behind its head, sharp beak and fiery orange eyes
nota: Cuervo solar de tres patas; ¿aliado de luz o jefe aéreo?

prompt_en: small pale spirit in a patched hemp robe with a round expressionless face, thin glowing eyes, long sleeves covering its hands and a faint cold glow around its feet
nota: Dudosa: no identifico «Sangja»; sin fuente clara, usar solo como relleno.

prompt_en: serene guardian spirits in layered pale pink and white robes with long flowing sleeves, soft golden glow, holding woven straw baskets and rice stalks
nota: Dudosa: servidores de Samsin (diosa del parto); solo lore o PNJ protectores.

prompt_en: gaunt ghost in a plain white funeral robe with disheveled grey hair, hollow sorrowful eyes, an empty offering bowl in its hands and trailing wisps of cold pale fire
nota: Dudosa: alma sin descendientes que le ofrezcan; versión de Gwisin.

prompt_en: tall masked monster with a large dragon-like head and wide gaping mouth of big square teeth, shaggy straw and cloth body in yellow and red, long swaying sleeves and a serpent-like tail
nota: Dudosa: monstruo de máscaras coreano; en una versión devora aristócratas.

prompt_en: sea court attendants with turtle shells on their backs and fish-like heads, blue-green scaly skin, pearl-studded armor plates, coral spears and webbed hands
nota: Cortejo del Rey Dragón (Yongwang); aparecen en grupo.

prompt_en: masked traveling performer spirit in a bright patchwork costume with long colorful sleeves, a grinning carved wooden mask, wide hat with ribbons and a small drum
nota: Dudosa: «gwangdae» son artistas ambulantes; no identifico el espíritu.
Es un juego ritual de fuego («quema de ratones»), no una criatura.

prompt_en: mountain-pass spirit in a weathered grey travelling cloak and wide-brimmed bamboo hat, faintly glowing pale face, a walking staff and swirling mist at its feet
nota: Dudosa: Mungyeong es una ciudad coreana; no identifico espíritu concreto.

prompt_en: large dark-green water serpent with a pale blue belly, glossy overlapping scales, a broad flat head with amber eyes and a faint crest of spines along its neck
nota: Dudosa: serpiente local sin fuente; en Jeju se veneran serpientes sagradas.

prompt_en: giant bat-like beast with a monkey-like body covered in grey-brown fur, huge leathery wings, large dark round eyes, a flat face with small fangs and long clawed hands
nota: Críptido javanés (1925); el catálogo erra al decir «acuática».

prompt_en: small sleek polecat-like familiar with glossy dark brown fur, long slender body, short legs, sharp teeth, glowing red eyes and a small bamboo tube charm at its neck
nota: Familiar de brujo malayo; guardado en un tubo de bambú.

prompt_en: gaunt ghoul with ashen blue-grey skin, tall hunched frame, long curved yellow claws, sunken red eyes, a banana-leaf shroud over its shoulders and a trailing rope of dried vines
nota: Roba cadáveres de los velatorios y deja un tronco de plátano.

prompt_en: lean pale ghoul with cat-like glowing green eyes, translucent grey skin, long curved claws, tattered dark cloth wrap, a faint second ghostly outline trailing behind it
nota: Cuerpo dormido y espíritu viajero; el doble fantasma no hace daño.
Es un modismo malayo (conquistador), no una criatura; ver buaya jadian.

prompt_en: shape-shifting humanoid caught mid-change, one half a human figure in simple robes and the other half a dark furred beast with claws, shimmering outline, glowing amber eyes
nota: Dudosa: término sánscrito de cambiaformas; no es criatura concreta.

prompt_en: tiny goblin-like dwarf with a wrinkled brown face, long white beard, oversized pointed red cap, earth-brown tunic, knobby hands and bare feet beside a termite mound
nota: Se pide permiso al pasar («tabi-tabi po»); ofenderlo trae mala suerte.

prompt_en: night-flying bird-man with large black feathered wings, a long hooked beak, sharp talons, thin hunched torso covered in dark feathers and glowing red eyes
nota: Nombre onomatopéyico: su chillido «ek-ek» anuncia el ataque nocturno.

prompt_en: swamp-green water ghost with translucent skin, matted hair full of lily pads, webbed fingers, hollow white eyes and a tattered mud-brown cloth dripping murky water
nota: Categoría literal («espíritu del agua»); misma figura que Mulgwishin, paleta de pantano.

prompt_en: tall shadowy humanoid with jet-black smoky body, glowing crimson eyes, long clawed fingers, a faint pale grey outline of a man's face and clothes, smoke trailing from its shoulders
nota: Sirviente de brujo que copia a su amo; el aviso falso no daña.
